posts.meta_description:
177K likes, 727 comments - ishanimitraa on May 16, 2026: "Hey you, don’t stop believing ❤️

Who knew a girl who just graduated from college, had to sit at home after working for 6 months because of Covid, started posting makeup videos which were 10 minutes long using her iPhone because she didn’t know how to edit or use a camera would be walking the red carpet at CANNES 6 years later?! 🥹🧿

From sneaking around and doing makeup to watching makeup tutorials on YouTube to googling & finding out that you need to buy a SEPARATE SD card to shoot videos on a camera to learning how to edit videos on an iPhone and then learning how to use a software and edit with a software via YouTube to reaching a global platform like CANNES baby!!!! 
Milestone has been hit 🫶🏼

It’s truly amazing what persistence and dedication for your craft can get you. DO NOT GIVE UP. Even when you see no growth because you might not be able to see it but universe is working in your favor on the back end. 🫶🏼

Outfit: @lovejthelabel 
Jewellery: @amamajewels 
Styled by: @janviturakiamalik 
MUA: @gurumakeupart 
Shot by: @alex.gingerlife".

posts.meta_description:
25K likes, 84 comments - ishanimitraa on October 5, 2026: "CELEBRATORY DINNER with @metaindia over my transition drop! 🥰 

It feels SURREAL, how can I be the first Indian creator to have her very own transition with her FACE on the app? AHHHH this is so big! 🎉 
Meta team @iishitag @tithi_sharma_ have been the best people to work with on this, they made the celebration so wholesome and fun. 🫶🏼😍

There was a lamp with my transition name “ISHIFT” and edits on the table which I noticed quite a while later, felt like a tube light ngl because once I noticed it, I was in awe 😭😳 
So well thought of! We had coasters and stirrers which had edits written on top, everything was so PERFECT 🤩👌🏼

Called a few of my close knit creator peeps & im grateful to everyone who showed up. Y’all are the G, love only 💕".
